Photo 1: The same two blenders, now with the white one showing 'PHILIPS' branding on the base. The green blender still shows 'PANSO' on the base. The white blender's jug appears to have a red tint or reflection.

Photo 2: The same two blenders, but the white one now appears to be a different model with a different base design and a single knob. The green blender is now on the right, and the white one on the left. The green blender's base shows 'PANSO' again. The white blender's base has no visible brand name in this shot.

The blenders appear to be used, with some visible wear and residue inside the jugs.
The background shows a cluttered indoor space with stacked items, possibly a shop or storage area.
